summary: must（肯定）may/might（可能）can't/couldn't（不可能）+ 动词原形/进行式/完成式，表示不同程度的推测。
signals: must have done 过去肯定

rules.title: 对现在的推测
rules.detail: must + do（一定，肯定语气）；may/might + do（可能，may 比 might 确定）；can't + do（不可能）。

examples.en: The light is on. He must be at home.
She can't be at school—it's Sunday today.
examples.zh: 她不可能在学校——今天是周日。

rules.title: 对过去的推测：情态动词 + have done
rules.detail: must have done（过去肯定做了）；may have done（过去可能做了）；can't have done（过去不可能做了）。

examples.en: The ground is wet. It must have rained last night.
examples.zh: 地面是湿的，昨晚肯定下雨了。

examples.en: He can't have finished it so quickly.
examples.zh: 他不可能这么快就完成了。

rules.title: 对正在进行的推测：情态动词 + be doing
rules.detail: must/may/can't + be + doing 表示推测此刻正在进行。

examples.en: It's 10 o'clock. They must be having a meeting now.
examples.zh: 十点了，他们现在一定在开会。

pitfalls: 推测句中用 very much 修饰：must 表推测不加 very
can 表推测一般用于否定和疑问，肯定句用 must/may
must have done 的否定是 can't have done，不是 mustn't have done

questions.stem: He ___ be at home now—the door is locked from outside.
questions.explain: 有明确证据否定推测用 can't be（不可能在家）。

questions.stem: She looks happy. She ___ have passed the exam.
questions.explain: 根据表情推断「肯定通过了」，对过去的肯定推测用 must have done。

questions.stem: The light in his room is on. He ___ reading now.
questions.explain: 对「此刻正在进行」的肯定推测：must be doing。

questions.stem: It ___ be Tom. He called me from London just now.
questions.explain: 证据表明「不可能是汤姆」，can't 表否定推测。

questions.stem: He looks sleepy. He ___ (stay) up late last night. (must + 动词完成式)
questions.explain: 对过去行为的肯定推测：must have stayed up。

questions.stem: She ___ (not; 可能) have heard the news, or she would have called you.
questions.explain: 对过去的否定推测用 can't/couldn't have done。

questions.stem: You mustn't have met him before, for he just came here last week.
questions.explain: must 表推测的否定式是 can't have done，mustn't 只表示「禁止」。

questions.stem: 他现在肯定正在飞往纽约的飞机上。（翻译整句）
answer: he must be on the plane to new york now.
he must be on a plane to new york now.
questions.explain: must + be 表示对现在状态的肯定推测。

questions.stem: 这个错误不可能是你弟弟犯的。（翻译整句，make the mistake）
answer: your brother can't have made this mistake.
your little brother can't have made the mistake.
questions.explain: 对过去的否定推测：can't have done。
